facts.claim: Flood effects can be delayed; odors, hidden waterlines/dirt and corrosion are clues; flooded high-voltage vehicles pose electrical/fire hazards.
Floods can affect electrical systems, brakes and airbag sensors; independent inspection recommended.
Not every flood appears in records and signs cannot identify every affected car.
Title/brand history and latest reported odometer are included; state practices differ; total loss need not mean physical destruction.
NMVTIS does not contain repair history; other resources and independent inspection may be useful.
History reports do not substitute for independent vehicle inspection.
